scimitaroryx: A scimitar-horned oryx standing in side profile: a pale CREAM-WHITE antelope with a russet-brown neck and chest, faint russet flank markings, a white face with chestnut cheek stripes, and TWO VERY LONG THIN HORNS SWEEPING BACK IN A DEEP SCIMITAR CURVE almost to the rump. Solid unbroken body and legs. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
bowhead_c: A bowhead whale CALF: a small stocky baby whale, smooth and blue-black with a pale white chin patch, an enormously arched upper jaw, no dorsal fin at all, and broad paddle-shaped flippers. Rounder and shorter than an adult. Shown in side profile, body one solid unbroken mass. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
swordfish: A swordfish in full side profile: a large streamlined billfish with a LONG FLAT SWORD-LIKE UPPER BILL, a tall rigid crescent dorsal fin, a deep metallic blue-black back fading to silvery white below, a large round eye, and a stiff crescent tail. Body solid and unbroken along its whole length. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
commersons: A Commerson's dolphin: a small stocky black-and-white dolphin with a BLACK HEAD AND TAIL and a BROAD WHITE SADDLE around the middle of the body, a rounded snout with no real beak, and a low rounded dorsal fin. The white saddle is one solid unbroken area. Shown in side profile. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
ringtaillemur: A ring-tailed lemur: a slender grey primate with a WHITE FACE, black triangular eye patches, bright golden-orange eyes, a black nose, and a very long tail RINGED IN ALTERNATING BLACK AND WHITE BANDS held upright in a question-mark curve. Pale grey body, white underside. Sitting upright, body solid. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
butterflyfish: A butterflyfish seen in full side profile: a tall disc-shaped reef fish with vertical yellow and white bands, a BLACK BAR THROUGH THE EYE, a small pointed snout, and a false eyespot near the tail. Tall dorsal and anal fins edged in yellow. Body one solid unbroken disc. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
ivorybilledwoodpecker: An ivory-billed woodpecker clinging to a bare trunk: a large glossy blue-black woodpecker with a heavy IVORY-WHITE BILL, a flaming RED CREST swept back, bold white stripes running down each side of the neck onto the back, and large white wing panels. Head and crest complete and solid. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
harpyeagle: A harpy eagle perched facing forward: a massive grey-and-white eagle with a pale grey face, a split double CREST of dark feathers raised on the head, a broad BLACK CHEST BAND across a white breast, enormous yellow feet with huge black talons, and a heavy hooked bill. THE WHITE BREAST IS ONE SOLID UNBROKEN AREA. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
owl_j: An OWLET, a fluffy baby owl: a small round ball of soft pale grey-white down with oversized dark eyes, a tiny hooked beak, and stubby half-feathered wings. THE DOWNY BODY IS ONE SOLID UNBROKEN MASS with no gaps. Perched on a short bare branch. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
bigfinsquid: A bigfin squid: a strange deep-sea squid with a small torpedo body, LARGE ROUNDED EAR-LIKE FINS at the top, and TEN EXTRAORDINARILY LONG THIN ARMS that hang straight down and then bend outward at a sharp elbow, trailing far below like threads. Pale translucent pink-white. Body solid where it is body. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
polarbear_c: A polar bear CUB: a small round fluffy white bear cub with a black nose, small dark eyes, small rounded ears and big soft paws. Creamy white fur throughout, THE BODY ONE SOLID UNBROKEN MASS OF FUR with no gaps at the shoulder or haunch. Standing on all fours. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
qinglong: Qinglong, the Azure Dragon of the East: a long sinuous Chinese dragon with BRILLIANT AZURE-BLUE AND TEAL SCALES, a maned serpentine body coiling through the air, deer-like antlers, long whiskers, a fringed spine, and four clawed legs. THE BODY IS ONE CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN COIL, never passing through itself. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
banggaicardinalfish: A Banggai cardinalfish in side profile: a striking silver fish with THREE BOLD VERTICAL BLACK BARS across the body, long trailing tasselled black-and-white fins, a deeply forked tail, and scattered bright WHITE SPOTS over the fins and rear body. Large dark eye. Body solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
jormungandr: Jörmungandr, the Midgard Serpent: an immense sea serpent with dark green-black scales, a broad blunt reptilian head, small burning eyes, and a vast coiling body looping through the water. THE BODY IS ONE CLEAN CONTINUOUS COIL, solid throughout and never passing through itself. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
kea: A kea, the alpine parrot: a large olive-green parrot with a long curved grey-black upper bill, scalloped dark feather edging over the back, and BRILLIANT ORANGE-SCARLET UNDERWING FEATHERS showing at the flank. Perched upright, body solid and unbroken. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
melonhead: A melon-headed whale: a slim dark grey dolphin-like whale with a POINTED CONICAL HEAD and no beak at all, a darker grey face mask, a pale grey throat patch, long pointed pectoral fins and a tall falcate dorsal fin. Shown in side profile, body one solid unbroken mass. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
barracuda: A great barracuda in full side profile: a long slender silver pike-like fish with a POINTED UNDERSLUNG JAW full of long fangs, a steel-blue back, bright silver flanks with a few scattered dark blotches, and two widely separated dorsal fins. Body solid and unbroken along its length. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
apollobutterfly: An Apollo butterfly with wings spread flat and open: a large white butterfly with translucent grey wing edges, BOLD ROUND RED EYESPOTS RINGED IN BLACK on the hindwings, and scattered black spots on the forewings. A furry white thorax and clubbed antennae. THE WING MEMBRANE AND BODY ARE SOLID AND COMPLETE. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
narwhal_c: A narwhal CALF: a small mottled blue-grey young narwhal with a rounded head, no tusk or only the faintest stub, a small mouth, and a low ridge instead of a dorsal fin. Plumper and shorter than an adult. Shown in side profile, body one solid unbroken mass. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
chupacabra: A chupacabra: a lean grey-skinned hairless cryptid, hunched and dog-like but standing on powerful hind legs, with A ROW OF SHARP SPINES DOWN ITS SPINE, huge red eyes, a long fanged muzzle and clawed forelimbs. Leathery grey hide, solid and unbroken across the body and haunches. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
stellerseagle: A Steller's sea eagle: a huge eagle with a MASSIVE DEEP ORANGE-YELLOW HOOKED BILL, dark brown-black plumage, bold WHITE SHOULDERS, white thighs and a white wedge-shaped tail, and heavy yellow feet. Perched upright. The white shoulder patches and thighs are solid unbroken areas. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
skunk: A striped skunk in side profile: a small stocky black mammal with a BROAD WHITE V SPLITTING FROM THE CROWN AND RUNNING DOWN BOTH SIDES OF THE BACK, a thin white blaze up the snout, and a big bushy black-and-white tail raised over its back. Short legs, small head. Body and tail solid throughout. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
europeanrobin: A European robin perched on a twig: a small round brown bird with a BRIGHT ORANGE-RED FACE AND BREAST bordered by soft blue-grey, a warm olive-brown back, a pale belly, thin dark legs and a small dark eye. THE ORANGE BREAST IS ONE SOLID UNBROKEN AREA. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
bloodybellycombjelly: A bloody-belly comb jelly: an oval deep-sea jelly whose transparent outer bell glows with IRIDESCENT RAINBOW COMB ROWS running in lines down its length, enclosing a DEEP BLOOD-RED INNER STOMACH clearly visible at the centre. The bell reads as one continuous body. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
predatorytunicate: A predatory tunicate: a stalked deep-sea filter feeder shaped like a TRANSPARENT FUNNEL or hooded trumpet on a slender stalk, its wide mouth gaping open like a hood, pale translucent white-lilac, with fine internal structure faintly visible. The funnel wall is one continuous translucent surface. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
